name: rops_pushover

spec.name: rops_pushover
spec.title: 横転の保護枠: 車の骨組全体を梁にし、塑性ヒンジを一つずつ入れてロールバーを横・後ろ・上から押し、乗員の空間との隙間を測る

checks.case: 1000 N across the tip of a 1000 mm cantilever, rect tube 40 x 80 x 2
checks.source: closed form delta = P L^3 / (3 E I), I = (b h^3 - (b - 2t)(h - 2t)^3) / 12 (textbook beam theory)

checks.case: fixed-base portal 1000 x 1000 mm, tube 42.7 x 2.3, sideways load at a corner
checks.source: plastic analysis, sway mechanism of a fixed-base portal H_c = 4 M_p / h, M_p = Z_p f_y, Z_p = (d^3 - (d - 2t)^3) / 6 (Neal, The Plastic Methods of Structural Analysis)

checks.case: the same portal, vertical load at mid-span of the beam
checks.source: plastic analysis, beam mechanism of a fixed-ended beam V_c = 8 M_p / w (Neal)

reason: R4-rops (横転の保護枠、OECD Code 4 の静的試験) を解けるツールが棚に無い (list_tools(test_id="R4") が空)。手計算 (frame_static.portal_frame_*) はロールバーだけの門形で足をレールの片持ちとみるので、車の骨組全体 (横の部材・反対のレール・柱) で塑性ヒンジを入れて押し、乗員の空間との隙間を測るツールを足す。
